City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 13, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the January 9, 2019 Regular Meeting and January 16, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-02-13 Item 08A Minutes
8B.

1. Adopt Ordinance No. 2019-01, titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, Which Proposes to Allow Emergency Shelters As a Permitted Use in the Business Park and Light Industrial Zones.”
2019-02-13 Item 08E Second Reading 2019-01

Notice of Completion for the Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk Improvements, a HSIP project (CS07B and HSIP 5446-018). Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar

2019-02-13 Item 08F Notice Of Completion - Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk

Review of the residential permit parking pilot program on Seacrest Way, Sea View Court and Pacific View Lane. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
Adopt Resolution No. 2019-11 approving the ongoing implementation of the residential permit parking program with the following modification: 1) Authorize the inclusion of Saxony Village Apartments in the permit parking program, and allow the purchase of parking permits for Zone C (Seacrest Way).
2019-02-13 Item 08G Residential Permit Parking Program

2019-02-13 Item 08H Bikeshare Ordinance
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS - PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10B and ITEM 10C): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10A.
Council to hear from applicants for the Commission for the Arts, Planning Commission and Traffic & Public Safety Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving on a City Commission; 2) Discuss as needed; 3) Make one appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Planning Commission - Cardiff representative with a term ending March 2021; and 4) approve the Mayor's recommendations for two appointments to fill the scheduled vacancies on the Traffic & Public Safety Commission - at-large representatives for full three-year terms ending March 2022, and one appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Traffic & Public Safety Commission - New Encinitas representative with a term ending March 2020; and one appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Commission for the Arts with a term ending March 2020

Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Development Services Director's approval of a two-lot subdivision for the property located at 2218 13th Street and associated improvements. CASE NUMBER: 17-206 TPM; APPLICANT: Lewis Bernard Massie; APPELLANT: Darren Kimble c/o The Law Office of Julie M. Hamilton; LOCATION: 2218 13th Street (APN: 264-143-41). Contact Person: Associate Planner Mierau
Staff recommends that the City Council continue the item date certain to March 13, 2019. This is based on the request received from the Applicant and Appellant to proceed through the City's Mediation Program.
THIS ITEM APPEARS ON THE AGENDA BECAUSE IT WAS A LEGALLY NOTICED PUBLIC HEARING. BOTH THE APPLICANT AND THE APPELLANT HAVE AGREED TO CONTINUE THE PUBLIC HEARING TO THE MARCH 13, 2019 CITY COUNCIL MEETING.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
